connect.title: Server
connect.description: Connect LuDraw to your team’s server (homelab or company). Boards then live on the server; this browser’s boards stay in Local Mode.
connect.urlHint: Leave empty when LuDraw is opened from the server itself.
connect.urlInvalid: Invalid address. Use http:// or https://.
connect.okNoOrg: LuDraw {version} server not set up yet
connect.setupPending: First-run setup is still pending: after connecting you will see the wizard (the token is in the server logs).
connect.incompatible: This server uses another API version ({version}). Update the app or the server.
connect.notLuDraw: The address answered, but it is not an LuDraw server.
connect.disconnectHint: Signs out of the server and deletes this browser’s working copy. Nothing is deleted on the server; local boards show up again.
connect.reloadNote: The app reloads to switch modes.
connect.modeLocal: Local Mode — data only in this browser
login.inviteOnly: This server only accepts new accounts by invitation. Got a link? Open it or paste the code below.
login.unreachable: Server unavailable. You can try again or go back to Local Mode.
login.serverNotice: Connected to a server: your boards live on your team’s server, with permissions enforced by it.
password.title: Change your password
password.mustChange: For security, set a new password before continuing (the current one was created by an administrator or by the server setup).
password.rule: At least 10 characters mixing 3 kinds (lowercase, uppercase, digits, symbols) — or a phrase of 16 or more.
password.saved: Password changed. Other sessions were ended.
setup.title: Server first-run setup
setup.subtitle: Three steps to get the server ready. It only shows up with an empty database and disappears once done.
setup.tokenHint: It is in the server log from the first start (with Docker: docker compose logs app). Lost it? Issue a new one on the server: docker compose exec app ludraw setup:token (without Docker: npm run setup:token).
setup.domainsHint: Separate with commas, e.g. company.com, company.co.uk. Empty = any domain.
setup.modeSingleHint: This installation belongs to your team. New accounts only by invitation.
setup.modeMultiHint: Each person will be able to create their own organization. It is recorded now; open sign-up is not available in this version yet.
setup.modeFinal: This choice is final: changing it later requires a migration.
setup.doneText: The organization “{name}” was created and you are signed in as administrator. Suggested next steps:
connect.useLocalHint: Boards stay only in this browser, outside the server. You can go back to the server at any time.
connect.locked: This app is served by your organization’s server; the address is detected automatically.
connect.localBlocked: Local Mode is turned off on this server by the administrator.
connect.backToServer: Go back to this installation’s server
forgot.title: Forgot my password
forgot.server: On this server the password is reset by an organization administrator or by whoever runs the server (admin:reset-password command). You get a temporary password and change it at first sign-in.
forgot.serverSso: If your company uses company login (SSO), sign in with it: the password is the provider’s.
forgot.local: Local Mode accounts live only in this browser and their password can’t be recovered. Create a new profile or use “Continue without an account”.
client.remoteChange: Someone saved a newer version of this board. Reload to see the changes.
client.linkRevoked: This public link is no longer valid (revoked, expired or replaced).
setup.celebrate2: Your team now has a place to draw together.

errors.collabInvalidChange: The change carried data only the server can set (authorship, lock or content you cannot see).
errors.alreadyImported: You already brought this board to the server.
errors.unsupportedImage: Image format not accepted. Use PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF.
errors.storageFailed: The server could not store the image (out of space or no permission on the image folder). Tell whoever runs the server.
errors.imageNotAvailable: This image is not available to you on this board.
errors.imageMustUpload: New images must be uploaded to the server before they join the live board.
assets.linkFailed: The pasted image comes from a board you cannot see and was left out.

errors.mailSettingsServerOnly: In a multi-organization installation, e-mail belongs to the server: set it with the LUDRAW_SMTP_* variables.
errors.mailFieldLocked: This field is set by the server variables and can’t be changed here.
errors.mailKeyMissing: To store the password here, the server needs LUDRAW_JWT_SECRET in its environment (the key can’t live in the same database as the password).
errors.mailAppUrlMissing: Set LUDRAW_APP_URL (or LUDRAW_PUBLIC_URL) on the server: without it, e-mails would have no links.
errors.mailHostInvalid: Invalid mail server address. Use a name such as smtp.example.com.
errors.mailHostPrivate: This address points to the internal network (local, private or metadata) and was refused. On a home or lab network, the server can allow it with LUDRAW_SMTP_ALLOW_PRIVATE_HOST.
errors.mailHostUnresolved: This mail server couldn’t be found. Check the name.
errors.mailFromInvalid: Invalid sender. Use address@domain or Name <address@domain>.
errors.mailIncomplete: To turn sending on, fill in the server and the sender and, if there is a user, the password.
errors.mailConnectFailed: Couldn’t connect to the mail server. Check the address and port.
errors.mailTlsFailed: The secure (TLS) connection to the mail server failed. Check the port and the security option.
errors.mailAuthFailed: The mail server rejected the user or password.
errors.mailSecurityMismatch: Port and security don’t match: port 465 uses direct TLS; port 587 uses STARTTLS.
errors.mailServerLimit: The server reached its hourly e-mail limit (LUDRAW_MAIL_MAX_PER_HOUR). Try again later.
errors.domainSignupNeedsMail: To allow sign-up with the organization’s e-mail, set up e-mail sending first.
errors.domainSignupNeedsDomain: To allow sign-up with the organization’s e-mail, register a domain under Organization first.
errors.domainSignupMultiOrg: Sign-up with the organization’s e-mail isn’t available in multi-organization installations.
errors.domainSignupDailyLimit: This domain reached today’s limit of new accounts. Try tomorrow or ask an administrator for an invitation.
login.domainSignup: Create an account with your organization e-mail
